name: Prat de Comte (Spain)
description: Green field with a yellow horizontal stripe in the upper part and a white horizontal stripe in the lower part.
history: The official flag of Prat de Comte is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, green, with an upper yellow fess and a lower white fess of thickness 1/6 of the height, set at 1/6 from the upper and lower edges respectively; the sun and the sheep of the arms have been transformed into the fesses of the flag.

features.role: fess of 1/6 set at 1/6 from the upper edge
fess of 1/6 set at 1/6 from the lower edge
